# Board Pack

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `EVIDENCE-GATED` `TIE-CHECKED` `PROVENANCE-STAMPED` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `CLIENT-FACING` `NO-AUTO-SEND`

## Why these badges

- **`EVIDENCE-GATED`** — Missing artifacts are gaps, not prompts to improvise. A pack built on an unclosed period carries a visible draft warning.
- **`NO-AUTO-SEND`** — This output goes to outsiders. You send it.
- **`TIE-CHECKED`** — Scripted spot-check that statement totals match the close's tied numbers before assembly.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ledger.pnl-by-month` | **yes** | integration manifest | P&amp;L export |
| `ledger.balance-sheet` | **yes** | integration manifest | balance sheet export |
| `REPORT-PREFS.md` | **yes** | client workspace — sections, audience, comparison basis, rounding, KPI list, format | ask once |
| `close artifacts` | no | closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/ — flux commentary, BvA, tie-out schedule, cash projection | listed as gaps with the producing skill named |
| `PROFILE.md` | no | client workspace — audience sophistication | ask once |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| board pack | self-contained HTML (print-ready) or markdown | client workspace |
| deck.json + .pptx | PowerPoint | closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/deck.json — via the mosofin-pptx plugin when REPORT-PREFS.md asks for slides; figures fed through adapters, never retyped |
| gap list | chat | missing artifacts and the skill that produces each |
| NOT TIED TO CLOSE stamps | on-slide marker | any figure whose tie-out row is red or unverifiable |

## What it will not do

- Distribute the pack.
- Invent a forward-looking statement — those are yours.
- Retype a number into the deck.
